description: A component to present content above an enclosing view, optionally with animations and transparency. Useful for dialogs, pop-ups, and overlay content.

animationType.description: Controls how the modal animates when it appears.

backdropColor.description: Background color of the modal container. Ignored if transparent is true.

hardwareAccelerated.description: Forces hardware acceleration for the modal window.

navigationBarTranslucent.description: Allows modal to go under the system navigation bar.

statusBarTranslucent.description: Allows modal to go under the system status bar.

onDismiss.description: Called when the modal has been dismissed.

onOrientationChange.description: Called when device orientation changes while modal is displayed. Orientation is 'portrait' or 'landscape'.

allowSwipeDismissal.description: Allows modal dismissal by swiping down. Requires onRequestClose to handle dismissal.

ref.description: Reference setter for the modal element.

onRequestClose.description: Called when the user taps hardware back button (Android) or dismisses modal via swipe (iOS).

onShow.description: Called when the modal has been shown.

presentationStyle.description: Controls how the modal appears on larger devices. Defaults depend on transparency.

supportedOrientations.description: Specifies allowed orientations for the modal.

transparent.description: If true, modal renders over a transparent background.

visible.description: Controls whether the modal is visible.

notes: animationType 'slide' slides modal from bottom, 'fade' fades in, 'none' shows without animation.
onRequestClose is required for Android hardware back button handling.
presentationStyle only affects iOS, particularly on iPad and larger devices.
transparent modals allow overlay effects; backdropColor is ignored in this mode.
